epic:#8345#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbfVSc1hXtxLUPHZ2f

**CI red on `a9f5abfd` — `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, step "ADR anchors + number uniqueness" (run 40767250949). It is this PR's, it is expected, and it is not fixed here on purpose.**

`node scripts/check-adr-anchors.mjs` reproduces it locally: `ADR-0144 is cited by 5 file(s) but names no record under docs/adr/` (the changeset, `field.zod.ts`, `object.zod.ts`, `field.form.ts` and the new test). ADR-0144 is the multi-currency record, and it lands in #27239. This PR is `Merge-after: #27218, #27233, #27239`, and Prime Directive #13 asks implementing code to carry its ADR's id. So the citation is correct. The gate turns green when #27239 merges and `main` is brought into this branch, which is already the planned next step. Rewording five citations now, only to restore them later, would churn the branch that #27186 / #27187 / #27188 build on.

Every other gate in that lane passed (60 of 61). Locally at `a9f5abfd`, the 112 derived gate families all exit 0. `check-adr-anchors` is not one of them, because the derivation scores it whole-tree.

Docs drift (bot comment 6480459047): the hand-written docs pages that name `currencyConfig` / `currencyMode` are left to #27189, the M0-5 currency docs page in the same release. This PR changes only generated references and the skills guidance.
